_doc: Manual identity links. '*' maps a normalised base from any namespace to a canonical model_id. Every entry needs a reason; never add a guess.

hailuo-3-max.reason: OpenRouter minimax/hailuo-3-max = AA 'MiniMax H3 Max' (Hailuo is MiniMax's video brand; same vendor, same version)

grok-imagine-video-1-5-preview.reason: Kie 'grok-imagine-video-1-5-preview' = AA/OpenRouter grok-imagine-video-1.5 (same version, Kie labels it preview)

gemini-omni-1-1-flash.reason: Arena 'gemini-omni-1.1-flash' = AA/Kie Gemini Omni Flash 1.1 (same model, Arena orders the words differently; Google blog link on Arena confirms)

grok-voice-transcribe-1.reason: AA Speech-to-Text 'Grok Voice Transcribe 1.0' (SpaceXAI): AA's own family slug for Grok Voice Transcribe is grok-stt; OpenRouter x-ai/grok-stt-1.0 = « Grok STT, SpaceXAI's speech-to-text model » (same vendor, same version)

grok-voice-transcribe-2.reason: AA 'Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0' = next version of the grok-stt family (AA slug grok-stt), named like grok-stt-1

voxtral-small.reason: AA 'Voxtral Small' (Mistral, 24 B parameters in AA's open-weights table) = the only Voxtral Small release, Voxtral-Small-24B-2507 (OpenRouter mistralai/voxtral-small-24b-2507)

rerank-3-5.reason: Agentset 'Cohere Rerank 3.5' = Cohere API id rerank-v3.5 (OpenRouter cohere/rerank-v3.5); Cohere names the model Rerank 3.5

grok-imagine-video-1.5-agent.reason: Arena row of Grok Imagine Video 1.5 driven by its agent mode (co-release); same model, different generation mode

Large v2.reason: AA STT row 'Large v2', host OpenAI = 'Whisper Large v2, OpenAI' in AA's open-weights table (same WER 4.06 %); OpenAI's API serves Whisper large-v2 as whisper-1 (OpenAI speech-to-text docs)

Gemini Embedding 2.reason: Agentset links its 'Gemini Embedding 2' row to /embeddings/gemini-embedding-2-preview (board updated 2026-02-15, when only the preview existed)
